candidates.claim: rtr-01 has a MGMT-addressed interface (GigabitEthernet0, 10.10.99.12/24) with no ACL bound to it and a default route via 198.51.100.1 on the OUTSIDE-facing Gi0/0/0, so MGMT-sourced traffic that reaches rtr-01 could leave to OUTSIDE without passing fw-01's MGMT_IN filter.
candidates.remediation: Confirm the intended gateway for MGMT, remove the default route via 198.51.100.1 or filter outbound MGMT traffic on rtr-01, and remove the second default route via 10.10.99.1 that points back at fw-01.

candidates.claim: The CORP_IN entry at fw-01:60 (deny 192.168.30.140/32 to 10.10.99.0/24) is a deviation from the approved baseline that was added and must be reconciled.
candidates.remediation: Reconcile the added CORP_IN entry against the approved baseline by either approving it into the baseline or removing it.

clarifications.question: Is rtr-01 meant to carry MGMT traffic to OUTSIDE, and which of its two default routes (via 198.51.100.1 and via 10.10.99.1) is intended?
